payload.summary: The full draft policy residents were asked to comment on, 78 pages. It covers how the council handles applications, objections from residents and responsible authorities, conditions, reviews and enforcement, and it adds new sections on determining applications, on service standards and on shops selling alcohol to take away, plus three flow charts for applicants. It is the same document that went to the March committee as Appendix A, republished here as a Word file. Two things to note: paragraphs 7.1 and 7.4 still read 'necessary and proportionate', the wording councillors asked on 5 March to be changed to 'appropriate and proportionate'; and the new service standards are unfinished, with their targets still written as placeholders in square brackets — calls and emails answered within [3] working days, licences sent out within [10] working days.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
